# Black Lab Development

> B2B website design and pipeline generation agency based in Cincinnati, OH. We build fast, conversion-focused websites for B2B companies — specializing in manufacturing, industrial, and technical markets.

Black Lab Development is a boutique web agency led by Michael Beasley, a senior web developer with deep experience in B2B pipeline generation, Core Web Vitals performance, and technical SEO. We work directly with founders, marketing directors, and sales teams — no account managers, no outsourcing.

## Services

- **B2B Website Design** — Custom websites designed for technical buyers, complex sales cycles, and pipeline generation. We focus on lead quality, not just traffic. https://blacklabdev.com/services/b2b-website-design
- **Manufacturing Website Design** — Industry-specific websites for manufacturers built to generate RFQs from engineers and procurement teams. We understand complex products, long sales cycles, and the specs buyers need before they call. https://blacklabdev.com/services/manufacturing-website-design
- **Conversion Optimization** — Audit, diagnose, and fix why your site isn't generating qualified leads. We measure before and after with real data. https://blacklabdev.com/services/conversion-optimization
- **Custom Web Development** — WordPress, headless CMS, Next.js, and fully custom web applications. https://blacklabdev.com/services
